verdict.rationale: Founder Law's own materials cover O-1A/O-1B, H-1B (transfers and lottery), TN, E-3 and L-1, plus green-card paths including EB-1A, EB-1B, EB-2 NIW and marriage-based cards, and International Entrepreneur Parole. It also offers choice guidance through a strategy session that maps realistic pathways and produces an immigration roadmap. Two items the story names explicitly are absent from the evidence: E-2 and cap-exempt H-1B routes. Missing for 10: any mention of the E-2 treaty investor visa, cap-exempt H-1B routes, written self-serve guidance comparing visa options, and independent corroboration.
